# pip-audit ignore list (TL-24).
#
# Format: <vulnerability id> | expires <YYYY-MM-DD> | <reason>
# scripts/check_audit_ignores.py fails CI when an entry has no reason or has
# expired, so every ignore is re-reviewed instead of accumulating silently.
#
# Reviewed 2026-09-28 against OSV (api.osv.dev): 4 pip, 12 torch, 1 joblib
# advisories. Each reason names the affected package and why it does not
# reach trustlens code. Re-check on expiry and delete entries whose package
# has a fixed release in the CI environment.
